opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison (FX to USD + supplier local time) emailed to procurement
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes ({amount_a} {currency_a}, {amount_b} {currency_b}) to USD on Xe, check which is cheaper, look up the current time in the supplier's city on timeanddate, then draft an email to procurement with the results.
steps: Open the Xe currency converter (Personal > Currency converter)
Select all in the amount field and type {amount_a}
Set the source currency to {currency_a} and the target currency to USD, then click Convert; note the USD value
Replace the amount with {amount_b}, set the source currency to {currency_b} (search the currency list) and note the USD value
Pick the quote with the lower USD value
On timeanddate World Clock, search for {supplier_city} and open its page; note the local time and time zone
In mail, compose To = procurement@example.com, Subject = 'Quotes: {item}'
Body: '{amount_a} {currency_a} = {usd_a} USD, {amount_b} {currency_b} = {usd_b} USD, cheaper: {cheaper}. Supplier time in {supplier_city}: {time} {tz}.'
Discard or send the draft

instances.values: item=CNC enclosures; 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY; city=Osaka
item=Shipping boxes; 8200 GBP vs 780000 INR; city=Pune

opportunities.name: Company account brief (SEC 10-K + Wikipedia) emailed to Dana
opportunities.description: For a ticker {ticker}, find the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, get HQ, employee count and CEO from the company's Wikipedia page, and draft an account brief email to dana@example.com.
steps: On SEC EDGAR, search the company box for {ticker} and pick the suggested company
Filter the filings by Form, choose 10-K Annual report, and note the latest filing date
On Wikipedia, search for {company_name} and open the company article
From the infobox, note the HQ, number of employees and CEO
In mail, compose To = dana@example.com, Subject = 'Account brief: {company_name} ({ticker})'
Body: '{company_name}: HQ {hq}, {employees} employees, CEO {ceo}. Latest 10-K filed {date}.'
Discard or send the draft

instances.values: HUBS / HubSpot, partial: only the EDGAR 10-K lookup was seen (no Wikipedia step or email)

opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync check (time difference + holidays) emailed to ops
opportunities.description: Use timeanddate's Time Zone Converter to get the offset between {city_a} and {city_b}, check {city_b}'s country holidays for {month}, and draft a sync email to ops@example.com.
steps: Go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter on timeanddate
Search and add {city_a}, then search and add {city_b}; note the time difference
Go to Calendar > Holidays, browse to {country} and open the current year's holidays
Filter to {month} and note the holiday dates
In mail, compose To = ops@example.com, Subject = 'Sync: {city_a} / {city_b}, {month}'
Body: '{city_b} is {offset} ahead from {city_a}. Avoid: {holiday_dates}.'
Discard or send the draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore; India; October; avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20
New York / Berlin; Germany; December; avoid Dec 25 and Dec 26
